article_context: A body infographic explains the article’s causal framing: reduced progesterone and estrogen dominance are linked to weight changes, edema, irritability, and fatigue. The animation should emphasize the central decline without altering any medical labels, symbols, arrows, or symptom icons.
image_reading: A square Russian-language medical infographic connects ovaries to decreased progesterone, then estrogen dominance, with four symptom branches below.
A translucent purple aura surrounds the central progesterone molecule; all other elements are static labels, arrows, illustrations, and icons whose displayed state must remain unchanged.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. Continuously erase the central purple aura from its outer boundary inward while steadily lowering its opacity, ending as a small faint halo around the molecule. Keep every other pixel locked.
models.scene_plan: Over 3.2 seconds, the maximum-size purple overlay begins receding immediately and erodes evenly outside-in at a steady compact pace while becoming more transparent. The camera remains fixed. By the final frames only a small faint halo remains around the molecule; the rest of the infographic stays pixel-locked throughout.
